title: BENCHCOMPASS: From Scores to Signals for Training and Harness Decisions in Payment-Domain LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.18270v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Payment operations are a critical financial infrastructure, but the value of large language models in this domain remains unclear because payment rules change quickly, evidence is fragmented, and decisions depend on transaction state, participant role, region, and payment rail. Existing benchmarks do not isolate whether failures come from missing payment-rule knowledge, poor use of supplied evidence, or brittleness under imperfect harness inputs. We introduce BENCHCOMPASS, a payment-domain benchmark whose construction pipeline builds scenario-grounded tasks from typed evidence packs, applies LLM-based quality checks, creates task-input attack variants, and reserves final item admission for domain experts. The release contains an expert-reviewed Pro benchmark covering payment knowledge, context-grounded scenario reasoning, and Attacked Open robustness, plus a lower-assurance Normal pool for inspection and future curation. Across 16 model

translated_title: BENCHCOMPASS：从分数到信号——支付领域大语言模型的训练与评估框架决策
translated_abstract: 支付业务是关键的金融基础设施，但由于支付规则变化迅速、证据碎片化，且决策依赖于交易状态、参与者角色、地区和支付通道等因素，大语言模型在该领域的价值仍不明确。现有基准测试无法区分模型失败究竟源于支付规则知识的缺失、对所提供证据的利用不当，还是在评估框架输入不完美时的脆弱性。我们提出了BENCHCOMPASS，一个支付领域基准，其构建流程从类型化证据包出发构建场景化任务，应用基于大语言模型的质量检查，创建任务输入攻击变体，并将最终条目的准入权保留给领域专家。本次发布包含经过专家审核的Pro基准，涵盖支付知识、基于上下文的场景推理以及Attacked Open鲁棒性测试，同时还包括一个保障级别较低的Normal池，供检查和未来策展使用。在16个模型上的评估……
tldr: 提出了支付领域基准BENCHCOMPASS，通过类型化证据包构建、LLM质量检查、攻击变体和专家审核的流水线，能够区分模型失败源于知识缺失、证据利用不当还是输入脆弱性，从而将评测分数转化为可用于训练和评估框架决策的信号。
en_tdlr: BENCHCOMPASS is a payment-domain LLM benchmark whose pipeline of typed evidence packs, LLM-based quality checks, attack variants, and expert review distinguishes whether model failures stem from missing knowledge, poor evidence use, or harness brittleness, turning scores into signals for training and harness decisions.
